evidence.title: Craig: README.md
evidence.finding: Documents Node22, Git, installed authenticated Claude Code/Codex/Cursor and gh for PR status; no Craig account or hosted control plane. Pi and orchestration are opt-in previews.

evidence.title: Craig: LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT license permits use and modification without a source license charge; agent services are separate.

evidence.title: Craig: package.json
evidence.finding: TypeScript Node terminal application depends on terminal-kit, node-pty and xterm; no graphical desktop/browser/mobile runtime.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/config/types.ts
evidence.finding: Runner discriminator is codex/cursor/claude/pi; config holds paths/enabled flags, local checks, GitHub polling and preview flags.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/config/runners/build-command.ts
evidence.finding: buildCommand resolves the configured executable and passes an optional prompt. It does not own provider keys, model catalogs or sandbox flags.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/config/runners/profiles.ts
evidence.finding: Explicit runner executable mapping for Codex, cursor-agent, Claude and Pi.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/types.ts
evidence.finding: TaskRecord persists stable task identity, lifecycle, prompt, lineage, runner tabs, per-repo worktree/PR state, checks, last commit and artifact paths. No issue labels, human assignees or requirement entities.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/tasks/create.ts
evidence.finding: Task creation validates prompt/runner, provisions local task state and invokes a required PTY launcher; failures are recorded.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/tasks/provision.ts
evidence.finding: Each repository task receives a craig/task_ID branch and separate worktree; project tasks bundle several repository worktrees and an AGENTS guide. It stores records before launch.

evidence.title: Craig: src/state/craig-paths.ts
evidence.finding: All workspace state paths are under .craig: tasks, runtime, logs, events, artifacts, commands, orchestration and worktrees.

evidence.title: Craig: src/commands/command-router.ts
evidence.finding: CLI dispatch exposes task/create-child, status, events, durable prompts, Fury, PR discovery/link/refresh, diff, checks and commits. Preview and agent capability checks guard orchestration paths.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/orchestration/delegation/service.ts
evidence.finding: createChildTask validates parent and allowed repository, uses an idempotency key, enforces child/depth/concurrency limits, records lineage and emits an attributed event.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/orchestration/delegation/capabilities.ts
evidence.finding: Scoped capability files use 0700/0600 paths, seven-day expiry, refresh, constant-time token comparison, subtree checks and revocation. Defaults: eight children, depth four, four concurrent children, 32KiB prompts. These authorize Craig operations, not arbitrary shell access.

evidence.title: Craig: src/shell/fury-runtime.ts
evidence.locator: approvePlan/runFury; reconcileFuryRun 224–305; review and completion handlers
evidence.finding: Opt-in Fury persists content-hashed plans, requires human plan approval, validates explicit structured step completion, waits on needs dependencies and human reviews, enforces concurrency/deadlines and reconciles durable state.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/orchestration/commands/service.ts
evidence.finding: Durable prompt commands have target identities, idempotency keys, delivery states and timeouts up to 24h. Delivered is PTY acceptance, not work completion.

evidence.title: Craig: src/shell/runtime/session-host.ts
evidence.finding: Detached session host stores PTYs and view leases separately from TUI/controller; disconnect does not dispose sessions. Explicit dispose terminates them; host death remains actual process loss.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/orchestration/events/journal.ts
evidence.finding: Local fsynced sequenced JSONL journal retains 16 x 256KiB segments by default, protects live-work segments, redacts sensitive key names, repairs incomplete tails and errors on expired cursors. Writable local records are not an immutable compliance log.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/error/adapters/error-store.ts
evidence.finding: Runtime/errors append timestamped records to a local JSONL file; no log upload exists here.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/config/version/check-for-update.ts
evidence.finding: Functional npm version lookup uses an hour memory cache and five-second timeout. No analytics event or client identity is sent by this path.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/tasks/commit.ts
evidence.finding: Commit stages all changes and records Git HEAD. Both review and checked states are allowed; passing checks are not an enforced prerequisite for committing.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/adapters/github.ts
evidence.finding: GitHub CLI authentication supplies PR creation/merge/status adapters; merge uses gh pr merge without an exact-head argument. Batched PR queries fetch checks/comments/review decisions.

evidence.title: Craig: src/domain/task/prs/open.ts
evidence.finding: Discovers and refreshes existing PRs by task branch, batches lookups and records per-repo project PR state; PR absence is distinguished from rate-limit failures.

evidence.title: Craig: packages/site/src/pages/docs/orchestration.astro
evidence.finding: Official docs identify orchestration as experimental; durable commands default when-ready, Fury requires exact-plan human approval, and prompt delivery is not semantic completion.

evidence.title: Craig: docs/rfcs/2026-07-27-rfc-agent-cli-orchestration.md
evidence.finding: RFC dated 2026-07-27 names Craig Homies as future persistent-agent, recurring-job and ongoing-conversation direction; outside fixed-DAG scope.
